mapping.draft_py:
# Starfield Mystic.
# s1: Watcher of the Spheres' CostModifier ("Creature spells with flying you cast cost {1} less")
#     with the filter "Enchantment spells".
# s2: no compiled exemplar for "is put into a graveyard from the battlefield". The event is a
#     ZoneChangeEvent BATTLEFIELD -> GRAVEYARD: the from side is Nine Lives' leave shape
#     (Zone(BATTLEFIELD, YOU)), "a graveyard" is any graveyard, and "an enchantment you control"
#     follows the landfall / "another creature you control enters" convention (zone controller YOU
#     plus CONTROLLER_IS YOU and the type in the subject). The effect is Lorescale Coatl's
#     "put a +1/+1 counter on this creature".
discount = CostModifier(
    filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Enchantment'),
    controller_ref=ControllerRef.YOU,
    delta=CostDeltaReduceGeneric(amount=QConst(value=1)),
)
grow = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        subject=FAnd(children=(
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
            FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Enchantment'),
        )),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [discount, grow, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Enchantment spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.

mapping.notes: Neither clause is exercised on the probe board. Packs in starfield_mystic/ pass: pack_discount (Leyline of Sanctity for WWW), pack_no_discount_without (control), pack_no_discount_other (Prismite not discounted), pack_counter (opponent's enchantment and an exiled one give nothing; yours to the graveyard gives one counter). No compiled exemplar exists for 'is put into a graveyard from the battlefield'; the event follows Nine Lives' leave shape plus the '<type> you control' subject convention. Engine note: the binder matches the from-zone by zone OWNER and the subject after the move, so an enchantment you control but do not own would not count (LKI edge, general).

clauses.clause: Enchantment spells you cast cost {1} less to cast.
clauses.evidence: No enchantment spell is cast in the trace. Packs: starfield_mystic_enchantment_costs_one_less (Pacifism cast for {W}), starfield_mystic_creature_spell_not_reduced (Pack Mastiff refused 'cost:mana_generic:0<1'), starfield_mystic_opponents_enchantment_not_reduced (opponent's Pacifism refused); pack also run against the packet's own tree (runpack --card --draft work_v1/drafts/<id>.py): same result.

clauses.clause: Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.
clauses.evidence: No enchantment leaves the battlefield in the trace. Packs: starfield_mystic_enchantment_put_into_graveyard_counter (your enchantment -> one PLUS_1_PLUS_1, 3/3; the opponent's enchantment and your artifact add none), starfield_mystic_enchantment_exiled_no_counter; pack also run against the packet's own tree (runpack --card --draft work_v1/drafts/<id>.py): same result.
